# Preface {.unnumbered}

## What to write in a Preface

1. Who are you? (Your background or personal connection to the theme).

1. Why does this book exist? (The problem you wanted to solve or the story you felt compelled to tell).

1. How did you do it? (A glimpse into your research process or the journey of writing).

1. Who is this for? (A quick nod to the intended audience).
